keyFindings.description: Rule 3 now asks only that some golang row carries ARG GO_VERSION, so nothing binds a FROM on a golang row to that ARG. Reproduced on a copy of the tree: a golang 1.28.0-alpine row added and every golang FROM (worker.Dockerfile:298, envoy Dockerfile:42, heldportwrapper:16) moved onto it while ARG GO_VERSION stays 1.27.1 passes check-ci-images.sh tree with exit 0; before this round it was refused. The worker's go stage would then compile with 1.28 while its toolchain stage downloads and its notices name 1.27.1. Bun keeps the binding through check-bun-version.sh (verified refused). Fix: refuse a reference whose row is a library/golang row at another version than ARG GO_VERSION, with a red case.

With the copy reading <repository>@<row digest>, nothing ever compares a row's digest with the version its upstream names, and rule 3 and check-bun-version.sh read that version from the upstream text alone. Reproduced by the deep review: both bun rows relabelled 1.4.5 with the 1.4.4 digests and .bun-version at 1.4.5 pass both gates and the copy; the Envoy listener's web stage would build with 1.4.4. Before this round the copy failed on that row. Fix: when a row is copied, check that the tag its upstream names resolves to the row's digest (or write upstreams as repo:tag@digest read from the registry, with rule 1 comparing that digest with the row's).

InPod is set only on the first boot's runtime; restart() at :225 builds fake.NewRuntime() again with InPod false, and step 5 relaunches the child's implementer, so the daemon takes the tmux answer and clones github.com/acme/widgets as before, now at step 5. The sibling proofs never restart. Fix: set InPod on the restart's runtime too (one helper for both sites). E2E run 40979438094 is still queued, so the fix is not observed either way.

The hand-written repository split is copied into the test, which then cannot catch a wrong split. crane (go-containerregistry name.NewDigest) drops a tag written before @, so the source can be row upstream minus its @digest, plus @<row digest>.

The header (:43-44) says the tag a row must carry is the full name-tag-eight form, while the code checks only the eight-character suffix. Every row already matches the full form; check tag == the rule's tag, or correct the header.
